issues.reason: Measures & units states "A scale no word supplies is never invented -- an unstated dimension takes the reserved slot symbol `unspecified`" and that no scale is ever taken from world knowledge; no dimension word occurs in "harvested nine buckets of salt-bloom", and `quantity` is defined only as the Degree-family scale in "(Degree <N> quantity <marker>)".

Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated restriction ("carry it, or leave the whole claim out and record the gap"), and (Time sk_lead_1 spring_tide) drops "new-moon" with nothing recorded, leaving the anchor shareable with any other spring tide.

gaps_confirmed: Ordinal day-of-year dating in a non-Gregorian calendar ("On day 525 of Year 2"): the Time term inventory presumes month/day calendar expressions and CE years, so (Day 525) and (Year 2) are used outside the range those terms define.

A named natural-cycle time used as a temporal anchor ("at the new-moon spring tide", "at the new moon"): Time covers calendar granularities, deictic constants and day-parts, `During` is restricted to during/while/throughout, and nothing states whether such an anchor stays a bare constant, becomes an sk_ eventuality, or how a modifier on it is carried.

A container-quantity expression ("nine buckets of salt-bloom"): the Possessive/genitive NP exclusion routes "a cup of water" to a measure but no section states the resulting atom shape -- which symbol bears the measure, whether a container word may fill the unit slot, and whether the count instead rides a bucket group's Cardinality.
new_gaps: Propagating a passage-initial date frame ("On day 525 of Year 2, ...") onto later clauses that carry only a non-calendar anchor: term propagation is licensed only off an explicit anaphoric temporal NP ("that evening", "the next morning"), so nothing says whether (Day 525)/(Year 2) may be copied onto the lead and Mira-harvest events -- which is why this parse dates three events, leaves the party-harvest undated, and then has no day term for "the next morning" to increment.
defect_summary: Issue 0: with no dimension word in the clause the measure must use the reserved slot symbol -- (Measure sk_bloom_1 unspecified 9 bucket) -- since Measures & units forbids inventing a scale. Issue 1: the "new-moon" restriction must be carried, which for a named time means the whole phrase as one time constant, (Time sk_lead_1 new_moon_spring_tide); if a multi-word descriptive time constant is judged unlicensed (the confirmed natural-cycle-anchor gap), the only compliant alternative is to omit the time atom and record the gap -- never the widened bare `spring_tide`.
notes: Sentence 4's "at the new moon" is dropped outright, the same construction as the confirmed issue, but the reviewer filed it only as a gap and I have not scored it separately. The rest of the parse holds up: the sentence-1 copular time-modifier dual-emit, the no-distribution treatment of the singular collectives "the harvest party" and "the Council", Agent (not Experiencer) for entity-object "reported", Theme for "recorded", and "the Council"/"a Keeper" as Name-less capitalized common nouns.
